attack_parameters.description: Scenario 6 includes two sub-scenarios, both using broadcast (true) ephemerides on route 1 from Bleik community house parking lot. Sub-scenario 2.3.10 has no jamming and spoofs GPS (L1/L2/L5) + Galileo (E1/E5) signals at 0.316 W. Sub-scenario 2.3.11 includes 5 minutes of initial jamming at 2 W (L1, G1, B1I, E6, L2, E5b, L5) followed by continuous jamming on other bands, while spoofing the same signals at 0.316 W. Start times are referenced to live GPS signals.

sub_scenario_2_3_11.jamming: 5 minutes of initial jamming at 2 W, then continuous jamming on other bands
